verdict.rationale: Supabase Storage is documented first-party as covering every part of the story: uploads via S3-compatible, REST and TUS resumable protocols, file permissions managed with row-level security and custom policies, and delivery through a global CDN in over 285 cities, plus on-the-fly image optimization. The support is mostly feature-list level rather than in-depth guides. Missing for 10: detailed docs on storage policy setup and signed/public URL serving, and independent or hands-on corroboration of access rules and CDN delivery.

support.subject: As a developer, I can upload and serve user files with access rules and CDN-backed delivery

citations.quote: Supabase Storage is a robust, scalable solution for managing files of any size with fine-grained access controls and optimized delivery.
Fine-grained Access Control - Manage file permissions with row-level security and custom policies
Global CDN - Serve your assets with lightning-fast performance from over 285 cities worldwide
Multi Protocol - S3 compatible Storage, RESTful API, TUS resumable uploads
